channel.title: RideMeme Digest — Philippine & world motoring
channel.description: The day's top Philippine and world motoring stories, auto-curated.

item.title: Mitsubishi Fuso showcases new logo, eCanter at 2026 PH Truck Show
item.description: Mitsubishi Fuso showcases new logo, eCanter at 2026 PH Truck Show AutoIndustriya

item.title: Toyota Tamaraw shows its versatility
item.description: Toyota Motor Philippines gave the Tamaraw several different jobs at the inaugural Philippine International Truck Show (PITS), which ran from 22 to 24 October at the SMX Convention Center Manila in Pasay City.

item.title: Can-Am returns on electric power
item.description: Can-Am is back in the Philippine motorcycle market after a 50-year absence, this time with two battery-powered models.

item.title: Tiny Titan: VinFast’s VF 3 tops Philippine battery-electric vehicle sales
item.description: VinFast’s compact VF 3 has become the best-selling battery-electric vehicle (BEV) model in the Philippines after recording 2,906 units sold during the first eight months of 2026.

item.title: CAMPI reports 20.6% September sales rise
item.description: Vehicle sales in the Philippines recovered in September after bad weather disrupted business in August, according to the Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines (CAMPI).

item.title: Geely unveils AI-powered charging
item.description: Geely Auto Group has introduced a new electric vehicle charging system that uses artificial intelligence (AI) to control battery temperature and manage power delivery, with its latest charging station capable of producing up to 2,250 kilowatts.

item.title: FOTON previews two commercial EVs
item.description: FOTON Philippines has brought two new electric commercial vehicles to the first Philippine International Truck Show, with one intended for refrigerated deliveries and the other for businesses that need a light-duty cargo truck.

item.title: BAIC owners gather in Tagaytay
item.description: A BAIC B40e owner had an unusual story to share when the brand brought its customers together in Tagaytay. He told fellow owners that he once drove through floodwater that reached the doors of his vehicle.

item.title: VinFast MPV 7 wins Marketeers award
item.description: VinFast’s seven-seat VF MPV 7 has won the “Inspiring Product Service MPV EV of the Year” title at the 2026 Marketeers Editor’s Choice Awards in Indonesia, where the Vietnamese automaker continues to expand its electric vehicle business.

item.title: Switching Auto Insurance Providers: The Pros And Cons Explained
item.description: There can be real benefits to finding a new auto insurance provider, but switching can come with its own headaches. Here's what you should keep in mind.

item.title: Porsche Expands 'Do Not Drive' Recall For Performance Models With Center-Lock Wheels That Could Fall Off
item.description: Owners of these cars should not drive them until a Porsche dealer has checked the wheel fastening system and replaced any out-of-specification parts.

item.title: 1970 Chevelle SS 396 For Sale With 24,100 Miles Shown Kept Its Original L34 In Huge Restoration
item.description: A frame-off restoration job brought this 396 Chevelle back to near-mint condition. It still has its numbers-matching L34 V8, and it's looking for a new owner.
